home.heroDescription: Verified social accounts, proxies, and digital data from trusted sellers — instant delivery, buyer-protected escrow, and transparent invoices.
home.categoriesSub: Choose the product group you need
home.howSubtitle: Get your order safely in three steps
home.howStep1Desc: Browse categories, compare prices, and select the package that fits your needs.
home.howStep2Desc: Your payment stays protected in escrow until you confirm delivery.
home.howStep3Desc: Check the product and confirm completion — funds are released to the seller.
home.whyEscrowDesc: Funds are protected and released only after the buyer confirms.
home.whyDeliveryDesc: Automated products are delivered right after payment.
home.whyVerifiedDesc: Every seller is verified for identity and product quality.
home.whySupportDesc: Our support team is ready to help whenever you need it.
home.review1Quote: Buying proxies in bulk is very fast, and escrow gives me peace of mind. I have used it for over six months without issues.
home.review2Quote: The account matched the description and support responded very quickly. Prices are more competitive than many alternatives.
home.review3Quote: The escrow system is transparent and disputes are handled fairly. The support team is highly professional.
home.faq1A: When you pay, funds are held in escrow. The seller delivers, you check and confirm, then the funds are released. If there is a problem, open a dispute during the escrow period.
home.faq2A: Yes. During the escrow period, usually three days, you can open a dispute if the product does not match its description. Support will review it and refund you if the seller is at fault.
home.faq3A: Some products are configured for automatic delivery. Once payment succeeds, you receive the account information or data without waiting for manual processing.
home.faq4Q: How do I become a seller?
home.faq4A: Create an account, submit a store application with your store and contact details, and wait for approval. Once approved, you can publish products and start selling.
home.faq5A: We support domestic bank transfers, e-wallets such as Momo and ZaloPay, and USDT. Your platform wallet balance can also be used for direct purchases.
home.faq6A: Data is encrypted and stored according to security standards. We do not share personal data with third parties except to operate the marketplace.
home.faq7A: Automated products are delivered immediately after payment. For manual products, sellers generally process orders within 1–12 hours, depending on product type and time zone.
home.faq8A: Yes. Many products support bulk orders with discounted prices. Choose a quantity at checkout and the system will calculate tiered pricing when configured by the seller.
home.faq9A: Funds are held in escrow until the buyer confirms delivery or the escrow period ends. They are then transferred automatically to the seller's wallet.
home.faq10Q: Do proxies and accounts have a warranty?
home.faq10A: It depends on the seller and product. Warranty information is shown on each product page. If a product fails during its warranty period, you can open a dispute.
home.faq11A: Open a dispute directly from your order, or email support@proxora.vn. Support responds within one business day.
home.faq12Q: What if my account is locked?
home.faq12A: Contact support with your registered email so we can verify and unlock it. Accounts may be locked for terms violations or unusual activity.

legal.termsP1: This marketplace lists digital goods and provider-backed services. Creating an account means you agree to pay into escrow, receive the described delivery, and not use purchased items for fraud or abuse.
legal.termsP2: Sellers are responsible for the accuracy of their listings and for fulfilling orders. The platform holds payment in escrow for the listing's warranty window and may reverse or withhold funds when a dispute is upheld.
legal.termsP3: We may suspend accounts that violate these terms, including chargeback abuse, credential stuffing, or resale of stolen data.
legal.privacyDesc: How this marketplace handles account data.
legal.privacyP1: We store the email and password hash you register with, session cookies, order history, and wallet ledger entries needed to operate the marketplace.
legal.privacyP2: The session cookie is HttpOnly and is not written to localStorage. We do not sell personal data. Payment rail providers receive only what they need to complete a deposit or withdrawal.
legal.privacyP3: To review or delete your account data, sign in and contact support from the registered email.
legal.escrowP1: When you pay, funds stay in escrow until you confirm delivery or the listing's escrow window ends without an open dispute.
legal.escrowP2: If the delivered item does not match the listing, open a dispute with evidence before the window closes. Upheld disputes can refund or replace the order.
legal.escrowP3: Escrow length is set on each product. Instant stock and provider-backed services follow the same hold, then release to the seller.
